layouts.name: Castle Combe Western Sprint
layouts.description: Draft configuration: The organizer's 2025 regulations explicitly start the Great Western Sprint at the pit lane exit and finish at Westway on the second lap, over one and three-quarter laps. The independent route retains the 188.9 m initial mapped pit-exit section and complete circuit before returning to the mapped finish. Every join and repeated lap section uses exact pinned source nodes. The 5360.4 m timed route differs from the catalogue scalar of 3006 m; the organizer describes 3.3 miles. Fine timing extent and historical lap count remain draft, without scaling or replacing the sprint with a closed venue loop. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 5360.4 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
